stem.en: Kabir says: "A mushroom is a plant. It grows in the ground and does not move." Where does the tape file it?

text.en: With animals, closer than with plants. Fungi and animals share an ancestor after the plant line had split off; both eat rather than photosynthesise, and their DNA says so. A mushroom is a distant cousin of Kabir, not of the moong.

feedback.en: Growing in soil is a way of life. No chloroplasts, walls of a different sugar, and DNA nearer to animals: fungi are their own kingdom on the animal side.
A fungus has a nucleus and organelles. It is a eukaryote, in the same domain as you.
Rotting is what fungi do for a living. They are as alive as the moong.

explanation.en: Looks file the mushroom with plants. Inherited features, from cell walls to genes, file it nearer animals. The tree follows inheritance.
